questions.subject: Programming skills · Conditionals
questions.text: A sorter checks red first, blue second, and otherwise uses a mixed bin. Where does a yellow item go?
questions.explanation: Yellow matches neither named color, so the fallback branch runs.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Conditionals
questions.text: A program first checks whether a file exists, then checks its size inside that branch. When is size checked?
answers: Only when the file-exists branch runs
questions.explanation: The inner decision is reached through its containing branch.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Conditionals
questions.text: If score >= 90 use Gold; else if score >= 70 use Silver; else Bronze. What label does 85 receive?
questions.explanation: Eighty-five fails the first test and satisfies the second.
